scope: Main292–298 through monotonic codes; exercises42–76; answers686–692 through76

exceptions.detail: Exact cycle/path classifications, component censuses, run-length optima, Beckett counts and complete trend-free lists in main293–297 and exercises43,56,57,63,65,66,70,75 were not recomputed. The long explicit 1024/256-step constructions in63/66 and every cell of Fig34 were not exhaustively traced. Research prompts48,53,62 were not pursued; supplied structural observations were reviewed.

For Feder–Subi45–47, the signature walk, elementary splice/parity reasoning, matching-parameter counts and asymptotic substitution were reviewed, with F0057–F0058 recorded. The omitted global choice of connector path in45(d) and all execution cases of that gluing procedure were not reconstructed. The exact 32-vertex example45(a) was not fully enumerated. Permanent bounds cited to section7.5.1 were accepted as standard external results.

The two-bit-update emulation42 was checked against the displayed register operations; its cited O(n)-space refinement was accepted without reconstruction. Fink’s matching-extension theorem55 was accepted as cited. For64, the permutation-product, padding and induction structure were checked, but all finite base bounds5–33, every boundary of the long stream and the r(1024)>=1000 numerical refinement were not independently expanded.

The Savage–Winkler endpoint recurrences, permutation convention, marker transmission algorithm73 and known X4 repair were reviewed without a full implementation. The printed length31 example72 and the second trend-free block construction76 were checked structurally, without exhaustive output verification. The basic trend-free doubling construction and the corrected distance upper bound74 were checked. Historical bibliographic attributions were retained.
